title: Dan's Boss
plot_source_plaintext:
Dan's life becomes a living hell when he cracks short jokes to a little person who turns out to be his boss.

Note: First appearance by Daniel Frishman as Vincent Daniels. Also Robert Englund plays a character who believes Earth is being invaded by aliens.
